description: Spoken transcript of a Meta video ad with timed segments — written copy as fallback. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

url.description: Meta Ad Library ad URL or ad ID. Returns the ad's written copy — headline, body text, CTA and landing URL. Meta does not expose ad audio, so this is not a speech transcript. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: facebook_ad_library_ad_transcript
title: Facebook Ad Transcript
